Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 6787- 1973 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PLATE, BONE, McLAUGHLIN 



I* Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of McLaughlin bone plates used as an implant in ortho- 
paedic surgery. 

2. Material— Any of the materials specified in 3 of IS: 5347- 1969 'General requirements of metal surgical 
implants'. 

3. Shape and Dimensions— As shown in Fig. I.

fig. 1 plate, bone, Mclaughlin 

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The plates shall be made In one piece to give the required shape. 

4.2 The holes shall be well-made and uniformly situated on the central line of the plate. 

4.3 The tongue shall have serrations on both the sides to hold the nail firmly. 

4.4 The bolt shall have clean and well-formed threads. 

4.5 All sharp edges shall be removed. 

4.6 The bone plate, the bolt and the washer shall be free from pits, cracks, burrs, blemishes and other 
surface defects. 



Adopted 15 January 1973 



® March 1973, ISI 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION

4.7 The plate, the bolt and the washer shall be passivated and polished bright. 

4.8 Screw shall fit in the plate holes perfectly and there shall be no protruding edges of the screws. 

4.9 Smith Petersen nail used with McLaughlin plate shall be in accordance with IS: 5846- 1 970. 

5. Tests 

5*1 Corrosion Resistance Test — Shall be according to 6.1 of IS: 5347-1969. 
5.2 Radiological Test — Shall be according to 6.2 of IS: 5347- 1 969. 

6. Marking— Shall be according to 5.1 of IS : 5347- 1969. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi I. 

7. Packing — The plates may be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. However, 
it is recommended that each plate, bolt and the washer may be wrapped in polyethylene bag or in wax 
paper and then packed in cartons.
